a.rule: Inverted e: top arch at row 1, upper-left aperture at row 2, midline crossbar at row 3, closed lower bowl in rows 3..5 with 2 shade modules at row 4.

b.origin: Derived (horizontal mirror of d / vertical mirror of p)
b.rule: Canonical o-bowl in rows 1..5 plus 1-module ascender at (col 0, row 0). Shade fills lower counter (cols 1..2, rows 3..4).

c.rule: o-bowl with right wall (col 3, rows 2..4) opened. Shade expands across cols 1..3 in rows 3..4 (6 modules).

d.rule: Canonical o-bowl in rows 1..5 plus 1-module ascender at (col 3, row 0). Shade fills lower counter (cols 1..2, rows 3..4).

e.rule: Closed upper eye (cols 1..2, row 2), midline crossbar at row 3, open lower aperture (cols 1..3, row 4) filled with 3 shade modules.

f.rule: Stem at col 1, top arch overhanging right at row 0 (cols 1..3), crossbar at row 2 (cols 0..2), 4 shade modules under crossbar in cols 2..3, rows 3..4.

g.rule: Closed upper bowl in rows 1..4 (shaded at row 3, cols 1..2), right stem descending through row 5 into full 1-module descender hook at row 6.

h.origin: Derived (n + left ascender at col 0, row 0)
h.rule: Exact n glyph in rows 1..5 plus 1-module ascender at (col 0, row 0), following the o -> d/b ascender extension rule.

i.origin: Derived (3×7 symmetric serifed stem + ascender tittle)
i.rule: 3-module width (3×7): tittle at (col 1, row 0), 1-module gap at row 1, top-left flag at (col 0, row 2), stem down col 1 (rows 2..5), symmetric 3-module base at row 5, 2 shade modules at col 2, rows 3..4.

j.rule: Tittle at (col 3, row 0), 1-module gap at row 1, top flag at (col 2, row 2), right stem down col 3 (rows 2..6), descender hook across row 6 with upturned tip at (col 0, row 5), 6 shade modules in cols 1..2, rows 3..5.

k.origin: Derived (ascender stem + n-style corner-stepped arm and leg)
k.rule: Left stem in col 0 (rows 0..5), midline junction bar at row 3 (cols 0..2), upper arm (col 3, rows 1..2) and lower leg (col 3, rows 4..5) connected via corner-touch at x=18 (like n). 4 shade modules in cols 1..2, rows 4..5.

l.origin: Derived (3×7 continuous ascender stem with top flag & symmetric foot)
l.rule: 3-module width (3×7): top-left flag at row 0 (cols 0..1), stem down col 1 (rows 0..5), symmetric 3-module baseline foot at row 5, 2 shade modules at col 2, rows 3..4.

m.rule: 5-module width (+1 module rule for 3-stem legibility): three 1-module stems at cols 0, 2, 4 separated by two 1-module counters at cols 1 and 3, topped by n-style notched arch (row 1: ####.). 6 shade modules in cols 1 & 3, rows 3..5.

n.rule: Left stem in col 0 (rows 1..5) with top bar cols 0..2 (notched at col 3, row 1), corner-touching right stem in col 3 (rows 2..5) at vertex (18, 12). 6 shade modules in cols 1..2, rows 3..5.

o.rule: Canonical 4x5 x-height ring (rows 1..5, cols 0..3) enclosing a 2x3 counter (cols 1..2, rows 2..4) with 4 shade modules in the lower counter (cols 1..2, rows 3..4).

p.rule: Canonical o-bowl in rows 1..5 plus 1-module descender at (col 0, row 6). Shade fills lower counter (cols 1..2, rows 3..4).

q.origin: Derived (horizontal mirror of p / vertical mirror of d)
q.rule: Canonical o-bowl in rows 1..5 plus 1-module descender at (col 3, row 6). Shade fills lower counter (cols 1..2, rows 3..4).

r.origin: Derived (n-arch with open lower right side)
r.rule: Identical top arch and corner-stepped right terminal to n in rows 1..2 (col 3, row 2 ear), with lower right stem removed in rows 3..5. 6 shade modules in cols 1..2, rows 3..5.

s.rule: Top bar (row 1), upper-left connector (col 0, row 2), midline bar (row 3), lower-right connector (col 3, row 4), bottom bar (row 5). 3 shade modules in lower counter (cols 0..2, row 4), mirroring e.

t.origin: Derived (ascender stem + symmetric x-height crossbar + baseline hook)
t.rule: Ascender tip at (col 1, row 0), symmetric 3-module crossbar at x-height row 1 (cols 0..2), stem down col 1 to baseline hook at row 5 (cols 1..3). 4 shade modules in cols 2..3, rows 3..4.

u.rule: Exact 180° inversion of n: left stem in col 0 (rows 1..4) notched at bottom-left (col 0, row 5), corner-touching bottom bar (cols 1..3, row 5) and full right stem in col 3 (rows 1..5). 4 shade modules in cols 1..2, rows 3..4.

v.rule: Symmetric outer walls in cols 0 and 3 (rows 1..4) stepping via corner-touches at (6, 30) and (18, 30) into centered 2-module vertex (cols 1..2, row 5). 4 shade modules in cols 1..2, rows 3..4.

w.rule: 5-module width (+1 module rule for unmistakable w legibility): outer walls at cols 0 and 4 (rows 1..4), recessed central spire at col 2 (rows 2..4), converging via corner-touches into twin baseline vertices at cols 1 and 3 (row 5: .#.#.). 4 shade modules in cols 1 & 3, rows 3..4.

x.rule: Upper legs (cols 0, 3 in rows 1..2) and lower legs (cols 0, 3 in rows 4..5) meeting via 4 corner-touches at central 2-module midline bridge (cols 1..2, row 3). 4 shade modules in cols 1..2, rows 4..5.

y.origin: Derived (u-cup in rows 1..4 + g-descender hook in rows 5..6)
y.rule: Open-top u-cup in rows 1..4 (notched at col 0, row 4 via corner-touch at (6, 24), shaded at row 3, cols 1..2), right stem descending through row 5 into full descender hook at row 6.

z.rule: Top bar at row 1, upper-right drop at (col 3, row 2), corner-stepped center bridge at row 3 (cols 1..2), lower-left drop at (col 0, row 4), bottom bar at row 5. 3 shade modules in cols 1..3, row 4.
